name: Cloudflare R2 Storage Tool
description: Read, write, list and manage files in Cloudflare R2 cloud object storage

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在对话中直接管理与读写 Cloudflare R2 云端对象存储文件（列出、读取、上传、删除）
description_i18n.en-US: Read, write, list and manage files in Cloudflare R2 cloud object storage

author: Custom

tools.name: get_r2_status
tools.description: Check connection status and configuration of Cloudflare R2 bucket

tools.name: list_r2_files
tools.description: List files and directories in Cloudflare R2 bucket with optional prefix path

tools.name: read_r2_file
tools.description: Read text content of a file from Cloudflare R2 cloud bucket

tools.name: upload_r2_file
tools.description: Upload text or content directly to a path in Cloudflare R2 bucket

tools.name: delete_r2_file
tools.description: Delete a file from Cloudflare R2 bucket
